meta.title: RayCarWash — Mobile car detailing, anywhere in Fort Wayne
meta.description: Book a vetted detailer who travels to you. Professional interior and exterior detailing at your home or office, on your schedule.

hero.sub: Book a vetted mobile detailer in minutes. They drive to you with everything they need — you get a showroom finish without leaving home.
bullets: Live ETA + photos when they finish

how.sub: From booking to a clean car, the whole flow is built around your schedule.

steps.title: Book in the app
steps.body: Pick a service, add your vehicle, choose a time window. You get an instant flat-rate quote.

steps.title: Your detailer travels to you
steps.body: We match you with a nearby, vetted detailer. Track their live ETA inside the app.

steps.title: Service at your spot
steps.body: They bring water, power, and pro-grade products. You keep doing whatever you were doing.

steps.title: Pay & review
steps.body: Pay securely through the app. Rate your detailer to help the community.

services.sub: Three core packages today, with add-ons for pet hair, headlight restoration, ceramic spray sealant and more inside the app.
services.footnote: Prices shown are starting prices for sedan-class vehicles. Final quote is generated in the app based on vehicle size, condition, and selected add-ons.

detailers.h2: Run your own detailing business — without the marketing.
detailers.sub: Bring your skills. We bring the clients, the schedule, and the instant payouts.

benefits.title: Own your schedule
benefits.body: Accept or decline any job. Set your service area and your hours.

benefits.title: Instant payouts
benefits.body: Get paid the same day jobs are completed, straight to your bank account.

benefits.title: Verified clients
benefits.body: Every customer is identity-checked. No-shows are tracked and penalized.

benefits.title: Built-in tools
benefits.body: Route planning, before/after photo capture, and a clear payout ledger — all in one app.

testimonials.h2: Loved by people who'd rather not drive to a car wash.

items.quote: Booked at 9 a.m., the truck was in my driveway by 11. Insanely convenient.
items.name: Maria G.

items.quote: My detailer sent before/after photos through the app. Felt extremely legit.
items.name: Derrick P.

items.quote: Full detail on my F-150 — looks better than the day I bought it.
items.name: Jonas R.

items.quote: Pricing is transparent up front. No surprise upcharges.
items.name: Anna L.

items.a: Fort Wayne, IN and surrounding suburbs (Aboite, New Haven, Huntertown, Leo-Cedarville). We're expanding — drop us a line if you want us in your neighborhood.

items.q: Do detailers bring their own water and power?
items.a: Yes. Every detailer arrives self-contained: water tanks, generators, and pro-grade products. You don't need to lift a finger.
Identity verification through Stripe Identity, insurance check, plus a portfolio review before activation. Ongoing rating-based quality control after that.
You get a flat quote up front when you book. We hold the authorization until the job is complete, then charge the final amount.
Open a dispute in the app within 48 hours. If the work doesn't meet the documented standard, we'll re-do it or refund you.
Absolutely. After the job, the app prompts you with optional tip amounts. 100% of the tip goes to the detailer.
Yes. Save your vehicle and detailer to schedule weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly cleans with one tap.
